notes: A Priming Tee (OakBarn Brewery, 2026-11-09): an Instrument Tee with a Manual Valve on its short side, always pointing up, to let the air out when priming a pump. Openings at the left and the right; the valve is opened by hand. It can Flip Horizontal but never turns or flips upside down. A TC Pipe Fittings Widget.
